android.desc:
Travelog is a beautifully designed travel tracker and travel map tracker 
for logging countries visited, cities, flights, landmarks, places you've 
been, and trip memories — all in one place. Build your personal world 
travel map, track your travel stats, and relive every adventure.

Use Travelog as your ultimate trip tracker to organize your past adventures 
and unlock new achievements along the way.

🚀 Core Features

🤖 AI Travel Journal
Automatically generate personalized travel journals with our AI travel 
journal feature. Simply add your photos and let the AI beautifully 
organize your trip memories.

🌍 Travel Map Tracker
Visualize your global footprint on a beautifully minimalist map.
Color-code regions and track everywhere you've been on your world travel map.

📍 Countries Visited & City Tracker
Keep an accurate count of every country and city you visit.
Perfect for travelers who want to track countries visited and build a 
personal travel map.

🏛️ Landmark & UNESCO Tracker
Unlock special badges by visiting 9,500+ landmarks and UNESCO sites worldwide.
Turn your trips into a fun collection challenge and achieve new milestones.

✈️ Flight Tracker & Travel Stats
Visualize flight routes, total distance, and detailed travel stats.
Analyze your travel patterns and plan your next big adventure.
